# VeloPair

> An open data standard for describing riders, bikes and riding styles, and the
> compatibility between them. Four JSON objects (Rider, Ride Profile, Bike,
> Compatibility) plus a Bundle container. Data only; scoring engines stay outside
> the standard. Version 0.1.0.

## Documentation

- [Specification](https://github.com/aydincan/velopair/blob/main/SPEC.md): the full spec, about ten pages
- [Research](https://github.com/aydincan/velopair/blob/main/docs/RESEARCH.md): primary-source research behind the field selection
- [Mappings](https://github.com/aydincan/velopair/blob/main/docs/MAPPINGS.md): correspondences to existing industry standards

## Schemas (JSON Schema draft 2020-12)

- [Rider](https://velopair.org/schemas/0.1/rider.schema.json)
- [Ride Profile](https://velopair.org/schemas/0.1/ride-profile.schema.json)
- [Bike](https://velopair.org/schemas/0.1/bike.schema.json)
- [Compatibility](https://velopair.org/schemas/0.1/compatibility.schema.json)
- [Bundle](https://velopair.org/schemas/0.1/bundle.schema.json)

- [Fast-road persona](https://github.com/aydincan/velopair/tree/main/examples/fast-road)
